description:
`discord-to-msg` turns a Discord message event, as the WebhookBridge bot posts it, into the unified `msg` envelope and delivers it into one of your UnitySVC rooms through the room's connector webhook — the reverse of `msg-to-discord`.

WebhookBridge watches a Discord channel and POSTs each new message as JSON (`message`, `display_name`, `message_id`, `attachments`, …) to a URL of your choice. Pointed at this service, the gateway maps that event onto the `msg` fields the room webhook accepts — the text as `body` (Discord markdown kept as `markdown`), the attachment URLs, and an `origin` of `discord` carrying the Discord message id and the author's display name — and forwards it to the room connector URL stored in your secrets. The message id doubles as the idempotency key, so a redelivered event is not posted twice. Free: delivery goes straight to your own room.

Store the webhook URL of a room connector (Rooms → the room → Delivery → the connector's webhook URL; it contains your room-webhook key, keep it secret) as the `DISCORD_TO_MSG_ROOM_URL` secret, then give WebhookBridge this service's canonical URL as the channel's destination. Paid enrollments ($0.001 / message) bind a different room connector each, reached at `/e/<code>`. See “How to use this service” for the setup walkthrough.
name: discord-to-msg
summary: Bring Discord messages into a UnitySVC room: WebhookBridge posts each message here, the gateway converts it into a `msg` and delivers it through your room connector.
